caption: The video captures a coastal scene at low sun, where a calm sea stretches toward a flat horizon beneath a heavy, cloud-streaked sky. On the right, a steep dark cliff rises, crowned by a pale multi-story building that stands out against the dim light. A sandy beach curves through the lower foreground, its edge meeting the water in a thin line of foam. The sun sits just above the horizon, casting a bright vertical column of reflection that runs down the center of the water. Throughout the excerpt, this reflection shimmers and breaks into moving patterns as small ripples travel across the surface. The foam near the right shore shifts slightly in shape and extent with each gentle wave, while the cliff, building, and sun remain fixed in place. The camera holds steady, so the only visible motion is the quiet, continuous breathing of the sea against the beach.
relations: Small ripples traveling across the sea surface cause the sun's reflection to shimmer and break into moving patterns.
Gentle waves shifting near the shore change the shape and extent of the foam line meeting the beach.
The cliff, building, and sun remain fixed relative to the moving water and the steady camera.
